full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D06B.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
STRUCTURAL READING AID:
1. THX, CCZ and QJZ available; DYC blank. Whole glyph is TWO vertically stacked components with a clear gap between them.
2. Upper component: ONE rounded U-shaped bowl with left/right outer uprights extending ABOVE a peaked inner roof. Chevron slopes join the left/right sides; its central apex has a SHORT vertical upward tick, higher than the two side tips.
3. Inside the bowl below the peaked roof, exactly TWO horizontal chords span fully between the sides. Together with roof slopes and rounded bowl floor these produce EXACTLY THREE stacked closed white fields: top triangular/roof-shaped field, middle horizontal field, bottom rounded field.
4. Lower separate component: THREE horizontal bars joined by ONE center vertical from top bar to baseline. Baseline longest, top slightly shorter, middle shortest; lower vertical gap larger than upper. This lower motif does not touch upper bowl.
5. Lower baseline width clearly exceeds upper bowl width; upper bowl about65–75% of baseline width. Preserve three upward tips on upper component (left side, higher center tick, right side), three upper counters and all four lower courses.
Critical count: TWO inner horizontal chords in the upper bowl, giving THREE white counters below the peaked roof. Do not add a third chord or a fourth counter. Upper bowl and lower stem/bar motif stay separate. Use evenly thick technical-pen courses with half-circlecaps rather than source brush pressure.
